Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill for 6 years now. I have a youtube bbq channel and this is one of the grills I feature on the channel. Just recently I was sent another gas grill by an up-and-coming grill company, and I did a comparison. The Weber hands down is a better grill for many reasons! For one, after 6 years of use, the Weber still out preformed the new one sent by the other company in BTUs and built quality. I can't say enough about this grill. Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Sturdy and built like a tank

Results.ReviewText: It was so difficult to connect a full tank of propane to this grill that I returned it to the Ace hardware store where I bought it.
Results.Title: Grill frustration

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber gas grill. I purchased it because friends had very good experiences with the quality and durability of the Weber gas grills. The quality was evident from the time I unboxed the grill parts to put it together. Every part fit together perfectly. The packets of nuts and bolts were arranged by the grill instructions. I put the grill together by myself in under 2 hours. I am extremely pleased with the grill quality and the heavy duty nature of the parts. I paid a bit more for this grill than the previous grills that I have owned, but I believe that the Weber grills are really worth the extra money. I hope to have many years of use from this grill...just like my friends have experienced. My first grilling experiences have been very positive, so far..I love it.
Results.Title: Well built

Results.ReviewText: Poor quality. My grill stays under a roof so it is protected from the weather. However I recently had a wheel break. In the process of changing out the wheel I discovered that the base of the grill had significant rust damge and was about to collapse. I expected better quality from weber.
Results.Title: Find another grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our second spirit grill. We left our last one with our house when we sold it. It was 10 years old. We decided to get another for several reasons.  Weber was always quick to send needed parts. Love the gauge that measures the propane tank. Also love that the tank is stored behind a door. For some reason, I can cook delicious food on this grill...probably because of the layout of the burners. And the assembly was super simple. Our last one took 7 hours and almost resulted in a divorce. Now the instructions are pictures and took only an hour.  I recommend this grill to everyone!
Results.Title: World's Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: We have a high end charcoal grill which we like but is a hassle to start and I smell like a campfire when done cooking.  We bought the Spirit to make it easier to start grilling and not have to deal with all the smoke.  We certainly accomplished that, but I must admit we miss out on some of the grilled flavor we get with the charcoal grill, which seems to be replaced with a hint of gas odor.  Its redeeming grace is the ease in using it.
Results.Title: General - after using it a couple of months.
